cards.title: Auto height
cards.body: Each card is as tall as its own content — the short one stays short.

cards.title: In normal flow
cards.body: Cards stack with gap between them and paginate like any other flow item, so a long list simply continues on the next page instead of being clipped to a grid slot.

cards.title: Data-scoped
cards.body: Bindings inside the card read the element, not the document.
